answer: To resist Sybils, networks enforce quadratic stake burning per identity: creating $k$ agents requires destroying $O(k^2)$ collateral, creating superlinear economic friction. An attacker cannot wander across forged IDs without exponential resource bleed. Rather than let counterfeit nodes shift like sand across a dune, the protocol locks every execution thread to a verifiable cryptographic proof, pricing coordinated manipulation out of reach.
